claims.claim: The headlights is Very neat as new one
claims.evidence: Witness report describes tail light assemblies (not headlights) and says they appear new/very good with no obvious cracks or missing lens pieces; no clear proof of 'as new' condition beyond visible exterior.

risks.risk: Wrong part type/fitment risk (witness shows tail lights, seller says headlights; vehicle compatibility not readable).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part number/OEM marking on each unit (or the connector side) plus the vehicle make/model/year the seller claims it fits.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a potentially non-matching used tail light set (worst-case fitment uncertainty).

risks.risk: LED vs bulb type not confirmed; wrong wiring/driver compatibility could make it unusable.
risks.proof: A close-up of the bulb/LED module area or the connector label indicating LED/bulb type.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown light type (worst-case treated as bulb-type mismatch risk).

risks.risk: Internal moisture, condensation, or failed reflector/segment not visible from the lens.
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing the inside of the housing (or a shake/tilt view) and a test video turning on all segments.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not tested (worst-case assumed may have internal issues).

risks.risk: Missing mounting tabs/brackets or incomplete kit (hardware/bulbs not shown).
risks.proof: Photos of the back side showing mounting points/tabs and a full set inventory (bulbs, brackets, wiring/connector).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as light assemblies only, with no guaranteed mounting hardware.

risks.risk: Aftermarket vs OEM unknown; quality and longevity vary.
risks.proof: Clear OEM/brand markings or part number on both units (and packaging/receipt if available).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case as aftermarket/unknown origin.

proof_requests: Confirm whether these are tail lights or headlights; send a photo of the full assembly installed on the correct vehicle (or a fitment reference).
Send a clear close-up of the part number/OEM marking on both units (front and back/connector side).
Send a test video showing all segments illuminate (and confirm LED vs bulb type).
Send photos of the back side showing mounting tabs/brackets and the connector/wiring condition.
Confirm whether bulbs and mounting hardware are included (show everything in one photo).
response.reason: The witness can identify the item as a pair of car tail light assemblies in very good visible condition, so a worst-case price can be set despite unreadable model/part numbers and unverified fitment/LED type.
